verdict: NOT database-driven. Every number on the model-math path comes from five canonical CSVs under data/canonical/research/{federal,derived} plus hand-curated constants in analytics/engine/config.py (FACTORS/MACRO, and EVENT_SHOCKS which is currently EMPTY). No sqlite3/DB read exists anywhere in the math path. The subsystem's only database readers are report_builder's story-ledger queries (narrative section 2.1, state scoping, reference-pack story claims) and they point at ROOT/work/events/ge16-events.db, which does not exist in V3, so even that narrative read currently fails closed to 'ledger not built'. The live canonical events DB at data/canonical/events/ge16-events.db (512 events, 117 stories, P2.8) is BESIDE the engine: nothing in analytics/engine reads it. Database evidence has entered the model only through human curation — the config.py EVENT_SHOCKS review of 2026-09-24 was performed against work/events/ge16-events.db and its outcome was to REMOVE all shocks — so the correct claim is 'CSV-driven model math with human-curated factor constants; database evidence informs narrative prose (and would inform it only after P3.2/P4 resolve the events-DB path), never the probabilities as of this trace.' Additionally, the whole report/pack/authoring layer is anchored on the absent V2 output tree (02_FORECAST/, work/, 03_REPORTS/, 05_AUTOMATION/): four unguarded reads (report_builder.py:71 FORECAST_JSON, :919 SCENARIOS, reference_pack.py:703/:984 SCENARIOS) crash those CLIs outright in V3, matching the recorded P4-class test baseline.
